about: 품질검사요청현황 ○집계 집계조건 칸 옆 [정렬] · [소계] 단추 (E040630, 2026-10-13 원본 실측) — 처음 올림 · 소계 표시, 월별을 내림으로 바꾸면 늦은 달부터, 월별 소계를 끄면 'YYYY/MM 계' 줄만 없어진다. 품목별은 품목코드순. QA재고2 요청 셋(지난달 품목A 5 · 이달 품목A 3 · 이달 품목B 2)을 넣고 본 다음 지운다.

shots.name: 담당자별 · 월별 · 품목별 → 정렬 · 소계 단추
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token'), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }; const it = (await (await fetch('/api/items', { headers: H })).json()).filter((x) => x.active !== false).sort((a, b) => (a.code < b.code ? -1 : 1)); const d = new Date(); const p2 = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0'); const cur = d.getFullYear() + '-' + p2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-01'; const pd = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth() - 1, 1); const prev = pd.getFullYear() + '-' + p2(pd.getMonth() + 1) + '-01'; const rq = 'QA재고2-' + (Date.now() % 100000); const mk = async (date, i, q) => (await (await fetch('/api/quality-inspection-requests', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ requestDate: date, requester: rq, remark: 'QA재고2', lines: [{ itemId: it[i].id, method: 'FULL', quantity: q }] }) })).json()); const a = await mk(prev, 0, 5); const b = await mk(cur, 0, 3); const c = await mk(cur, 1, 2); sessionStorage.setItem('qras', JSON.stringify({ rq, ids: [a.id, b.id, c.id], n0: it[0].name + (it[0].spec ? ' [' + it[0].spec + ']' : ''), n1: it[1].name + (it[1].spec ? ' [' + it[1].spec + ']' : ''), prevM: prev.slice(0, 7).replace('-', '/'), curM: cur.slice(0, 7).replace('-', '/'), from: prev })); return [a.requestNo, b.requestNo, c.requestNo].join(' / ') })()

js:(async () => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qras')); const W = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const S = (el, v) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })) }; S(document.querySelector('input[type=date]'), x.from); await W(1500); const rq = [...document.querySelectorAll('li')].find((li) => li.innerText.trim().startsWith('품질검사요청No.')).querySelector('input'); S(rq, 'QR-'); [...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find((l) => l.innerText.trim() === '집계').querySelector('input').click(); await W(400); return 'ok' })()

expect:(() => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qras')); const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].map((r) => [...r.cells].map((c) => c.innerText.trim()).join('|')); const i = rows.findIndex((r) => r.startsWith(x.rq + '|')); return i >= 0 && rows.slice(i, i + 9).join('‖') === [x.rq + '|' + x.prevM + '|' + x.n0 + '|5.00', x.n0 + ' 계|5.00', x.prevM + ' 계|5.00', x.rq + '|' + x.curM + '|' + x.n0 + '|3.00', x.n0 + ' 계|3.00', x.rq + '|' + x.curM + '|' + x.n1 + '|2.00', x.n1 + ' 계|2.00', x.curM + ' 계|5.00', x.rq + ' 계|10.00'].join('‖') })()

expect:(() => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qras')); const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].map((r) => [...r.cells].map((c) => c.innerText.trim()).join('|')); const i = rows.findIndex((r) => r.startsWith(x.rq + '|')); return rows[i] === x.rq + '|' + x.curM + '|' + x.n0 + '|3.00' })()

expect:(async () => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qras')); const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const rs = await Promise.all(x.ids.map((id) => fetch('/api/quality-inspection-requests/' + id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }))); return rs.every((r) => r.status === 204) })()
